last_outcome: M1-05 split (iteration 19): M1-05 was size L, topmost todo with deps done, so per docs/LOOP.md §2 the whole iteration was the split, not a feature. Replaced it with M1-12 (S, pure route-projection geometry in packages/flight-sim), M1-13 (M, resolves ADR-007 and draws the static route -- the actual renderer decision + first real screen render), and M1-14 (S, the flown-solid/remaining-dashed split), in that dependency order; M1-06's Depends-on line now points at M1-14 instead of the retired M1-05. M1-05 itself kept status 'split' (not 'done') with its checkbox left unticked, since gate:roadmap requires a done item to be covered by a test literally named '[M1-05]' and no such test will ever exist once the real work lands under the new IDs -- 'split' is a non-todo, non-done status like the existing 'blocked' convention, so the loop's topmost-todo selection rule will never reselect it. Also discovered and avoided a real gate-breaking mistake before committing: an ID with a trailing letter suffix (tried M1-05a/b/c first) silently fails check-roadmap-tests.mjs's item regex ([A-Z]\d+-\d+, digits only, no letter suffix), which would make that item invisible to the honesty gate rather than erroring loudly -- renamed to plain next-available numeric IDs (M1-12/13/14) instead. pnpm run verify green throughout (162 tests unchanged, floor unchanged); gate:roadmap now reports 20 done / 9 pending (was 6 pending pre-split, net +3 from the one L item becoming three).
